svg.title: How a match works
svg.desc: Five steps: queue, lobby, match, result, rank. Queue: Join from Discord or the site. One click in, one click out. Lobby: The queue pops. Ready up in voice, then vote the map. Match: Team voice channels, a host and a lobby code. Result: One team reports, the other confirms. Disputes go to staff. Rank: Your rating, the season and the leaderboard move.
